bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
printf 'BOT_RUNNING=%s\n' "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null || echo missing)"
printf 'BOT_RESTARTS=%s\n' "$(docker inspect -f '{{.RestartCount}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null || echo missing)"
printf 'BOT_IMAGE_TAG=%s\n' "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null || echo missing)"
printf 'BOT_POLL_READY=%s\n' "$(docker logs --tail 300 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -c '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$' || true)"
printf 'BOT_GATE_CONNECTED=%s\n' "$(docker logs --tail 300 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -c '^CREATOR_GATE_PUBLIC_RELEASE=CONNECTED$' || true)"
printf 'BOT_ERROR_CLASSES='
docker logs --tail 160 "$name" 2>&1 | sed -nE 's/^(CREATOR_[A-Z_]+)=.*/\1/p' | sort -u | tr '\n' ','
printf '\n'
printf 'BOT_POLL_CONTAINER_COUNT=%s\n' "$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ec 'createvdobot|create-videobot|videobot-poll' || true)"
